summary.en:
In the interrogation room, Takahiro Matoi tells the police that he could not recall a thing after he had drinks with the victim, Shiori Jojima, and two other colleagues.

Location: Roadway in Beika

Victim: Shiori Jojima

suspects: Takahiro Matoi, Shigeki Natsuhara and Shohei Yumura
